language.label: Language
language.hint: The language of the interface and of the course content that has been translated.

failure.offline: You are offline. Your answer is kept and will be sent when the connection returns.
failure.timeout: The server took too long to answer. Your answer is kept.
failure.network: The connection dropped before the answer arrived. It is still in the box.
failure.auth: Your session ended. Sign in again and the answer can be sent.
failure.throttled: Saving is catching up, your answer is kept and will be sent again.
failure.notFound: The server forgot this run. Restart it to continue.
failure.gateway: The server is restarting. Retry in a moment, your answer is kept.
failure.server: The server hit an error while grading. Retrying the same answer will not change it.
failure.parse: The server answered in a form this page could not read. Reload to continue.
failure.other: Couldn't submit your answer, it's still in the box.
